missing.why: Takedowns refresh On The Hunt's duration, not a cooldown. Not missing; expect some rejected Guesses.
Final Hour's duration is extended on takedowns, not reset. Not missing.
Reckless Swing refunds its Health cost on kill, not its cooldown. Not missing.

disputable.why: Only his passive's cooldown drops, and only on kills, not assists; players will argue a mana-restore passive isn't 'an ability that resets'.

aliases.why: Players drop the apostrophe; check it already normalises, else add.
Standard short form with no space.

fun.why: Katarina and Darius come instantly, but 22 answers spread across every role, with satisfying finds like Vex, Akshan and Aurora.

champion:Katarina.why: The reset champion everyone names first.

champion:Tristana.why: Rocket Jump resets are widely known even without the Rule naming her.

champion:Pyke.why: Death from Below recasts are famous.

champion:Khazix.why: Evolved Leap reset is well known.

champion:Irelia.why: Bladesurge resets are known, mostly from minion kills.

champion:Samira.why: Wild Rush reset is known to ADC players.

champion:Ahri.why: Extra Spirit Rush charges on takedown are moderately known.

champion:Talon.why: Noxian Diplomacy refund is a second-tier recall.

champion:Kalista.why: Rend resets on kill are known, mostly from last-hitting.

champion:Akshan.why: Heroic Swing reset is real but not his headline mechanic.

champion:Leblanc.why: Sigil of Malice refund is rarely named.

champion:Naafiri.why: The Call of the Pack recast is niche.

champion:Vex.why: Shadow Surge reset is known by Vex players.

champion:Twitch.why: Ambush refresh on takedown is little known.

champion:Fizz.why: Seastone Trident's on-kill cooldown is obscure.

champion:Annie.why: Disintegrate refund is thought of as a minion trick.

champion:Aurora.why: Newer champion; W reset not widely known.

champion:Zyra.why: Seed recharge on takedown is very obscure.

champion:Locke.why: Newest champion; few know his kit.

champion:Nidalee.why: Pounce resetting on takedowns is known mostly to Nidalee players.

champion:Xerath.why: Mana Surge's on-kill cooldown is almost unknown and not an ability players think of.

Heroic Swing refreshing on takedowns is a satisfying reveal for a well-known champion.
Ambush refreshing on takedown is real and fun to learn. The suggested Tristana still fails: about 0.25 and 6th of 24 by Typicality.
